# Travel Explorer

> Travel Explorer is a travel discovery website providing destination
> information, travel inspiration and travel guides.

## Website

https://shinchan111.github.io/project/
## Main Pages

- Home: https://shinchan111.github.io/project/
- Destinations: https://shinchan111.github.io/project/destinations.html
- About: https://shinchan111.github.io/project/about.html
- Contact: https://shinchan111.github.io/project/contact.html

## Destinations

Travel Explorer provides information and inspiration about destinations
including:

- Paris, France
- Bali, Indonesia
- Switzerland
- Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Japan
- Maldives

## Topics

The website focuses on:

- Travel destinations
- Vacation ideas
- Travel inspiration
- Destination guides
- World travel
- Adventure travel
- Travel planning
